janya_ragas.audit_note: Original exercise data preserved. Check varjya-note handling and event-to-pitch alignment before release.

quality_status.basis: Structural review of the supplied JSON and spot-checks of exercise notation.
quality_status.important_notice: This update documents validation requirements and does not claim that the musical content has been corrected.

known_findings.finding: Some exercises retain solfa tokens for notes listed as varjya in the rāga metadata, while the swarasthana field marks corresponding notes in parentheses.
known_findings.required_action: Review and correct solfa, swarasthana, vowelSyllables, semitones, and webNotation together for every exercise-direction.

known_findings.finding: Token-to-semitone alignment must be checked with the app’s actual notation parser, including octave markers, rests, duration holds, and parenthesized annotations.
known_findings.required_action: Run event-level validation using the playback engine’s notation contract; do not rely on whitespace token counts alone.

known_findings.finding: A JSON structure/count check is not proof of rāga correctness or traditional phrase validity.
known_findings.required_action: Review arohana/avarohana, directional varjya rules, and exercise phrases with a qualified Carnatic music reviewer.

release_gate: All exercise note events agree with the declared rāga and directional rules, or have documented and reviewed exceptions.
